## The combine formula

Each rank computes a local attention over its subset of KV blocks. For a single
query row, rank $r$ produces:

$$
o_r = \frac{\sum_j s_{r,j}\, v_{r,j}}{\sum_j s_{r,j}}, \qquad
\ell_r = \log\!\Bigl(\sum_j s_{r,j}\Bigr)
$$

where $s_{r,j} = \exp(q\!\cdot\! k_{r,j} - m_r)$ and $m_r$ is the local max
used for numerical stability. The global result is the log-sum-exp merge of the
per-rank $(o_r, \ell_r)$ pairs:

$$
m = \max_r \ell_r, \qquad
o = \frac{\sum_r \exp(\ell_r - m)\, o_r}{\sum_r \exp(\ell_r - m)}, \qquad
\ell = m + \log\!\sum_r \exp(\ell_r - m)
$$

This is the standard ring-attention / flash-attention cross-block reduction.
